subject: session date
fact: The events occur on Planting 23, 579.
source_quote: ### Planting 23, 579

subject: session date
fact: The events continue on Planting 24, 579.
source_quote: ### Planting 24, 579

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer was knocked out during the battle.
source_quote: Sequoia, and Zinna were knocked out. Calmer healed them.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer was knocked out again by Thalsor after attempting to heal Sequoia and Zinnia.
source_quote: Calmer tried to heal them again, but Thalsor knocked him out.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer was killed by Thalsor.
source_quote: I saved Sequoia and Zinnia. And then just as I was about to get Calmer’s body, Thalsor killed him.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer’s body was targeted for mutilation by Thalsor to prevent resurrection.
source_quote: The bastard will mutilate the body, making it impossible to raise him from the dead.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer’s body was recovered intact by Sequoia.
source_quote: Sequoia materializes, grabs calmer’s body and runs.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer’s body was intact and could be raised from the dead.
source_quote: Calmer’s dead body is on the ground. Intact. It can be raised.

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor attacked and killed Calmer.
source_quote: I saved Sequoia and Zinnia. And then just as I was about to get Calmer’s body, Thalsor killed him.

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor threatened to mutilate Calmer’s body.
source_quote: “I know you want your friend back. I want to know who sent you. Give me that information, and I will not mutilate his body.”

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor promised retribution of earth and evil.
source_quote: Thalsor screams his plans to kill and mutilate and destroy and promises the retribution of earth and evil

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor was wounded and remained inside his compound.
source_quote: He’s wounded too. And he doesn’t want to die.

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor was killed by Zinnia and Zephyr’s attacks.
source_quote: My attacks and Zephyr’s attacks strike him down quickly.

subject: mud mephit
fact: A mud mephit remained after Thalsor’s death.
source_quote: Only a mud mephit remains

subject: mud mephit
fact: The mud mephit was killed by the party.
source_quote: and we kill that too.

subject: golem
fact: The golem was immobile after Thalsor’s death.
source_quote: The golem is immobile.

subject: Thalsor’s compound
fact: Thalsor remained inside his compound and did not leave.
source_quote: he’s not coming out of his compound.

subject: chest
fact: The chest was stolen by cultists and was the target of the mission.
source_quote: we now need to get what we came for, the chest Lareth wanted.

subject: honey
fact: The party recovered honey that Pasmarie Clee was seeking.
source_quote: we now need to get what we came for, the chest Lareth wanted. And the honey that Pasmarie Clee was looking for.

subject: honey
fact: The party returned the honey to Pasmarie Clee in Sheernobb.
source_quote: The first stop was to Pasmarie Clee in Sheernobb, where we returned her honey

subject: magical trident
fact: Zinnia gave up a magical trident as a tithe to Terjon to revive Calmer.
source_quote: I made the difficult decision to give up a magical trident, offering it as a tithe to Terjon at the Temple of St. Cuthbert

subject: letter of permit
fact: Gonnathrad Kevanarial issued a letter of permit hiring the party to pursue the chest.
source_quote: he actually gave us a letter of permit, officially hiring us to pursue a lead regarding the chest near a monastery by Gallow's Corner

subject: letter of permit
fact: The letter of permit promised 100 gold pieces upon presentation to Caer Ostverk.
source_quote: it promised 100 gold pieces as a reward when presented to Caer Ostverk

subject: monastery
fact: The lost chest was located in a monastery in the mountains.
source_quote: notes indicating the lost chest was located in a monastery within the mountains

subject: monastery
fact: The monastery was identified as abandoned and near Gallow's Corner.
source_quote: he eventually recalled an abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner

subject: Sheernobb
fact: The party returned the honey to Pasmarie Clee in Sheernobb.
source_quote: The first stop was to Pasmarie Clee in Sheernobb

subject: Hommlet
fact: The party returned to Hommlet after securing the honey and before traveling to Ostverk.
source_quote: Our return to Hommlet was punctuated by the pressing need to share this new information

subject: Ostverk
fact: The party traveled to Ostverk to follow the lead on the chest.
source_quote: we headed to Ostverk

subject: The Cheap Forester
fact: The party gathered intelligence at The Cheap Forester tavern in Ostverk.
source_quote: we made our way to "The Cheap Forester," a local tavern.

subject: Robert Deakin
fact: Robert Deakin is a gnome and the owner of The Cheap Forester tavern.
source_quote: The tavern keeper, Robert Deakin, a gnome, insisted we purchase food before he’d talk.

subject: Robert Deakin
fact: Robert Deakin claimed to have fought in the Battle of Emiry Meadows.
source_quote: He claimed to know because he had fought in the Battle of Emiry Meadows

subject: Robert Deakin
fact: Robert Deakin believed the chest was meant to secure a treaty with Celene to wage war on the gnomes.
source_quote: the chest's true purpose was to secure a treaty with the Kingdom of Celene. The Viscounty (Verbobonc) intended to use this alliance to wage war on the gnomes and seize their gem mines.

subject: Robert Deakin
fact: Robert Deakin was glad the alliance with Celene had not formed.
source_quote: Deakin, being a gnome, was clearly displeased by this, and surprisingly, was glad the alliance hadn't formed.

subject: Robert Deakin
fact: Robert Deakin is related to the Clee family.
source_quote: Deakin mentioned he was related to the Clee family

subject: Rithelm Drake
fact: Rithelm Drake is a human soldier with a square face and green eyes.
source_quote: Rithelm Drake, a human soldier, who presented as a massive man of average height with a square face and rough, pink skin.

subject: Rithelm Drake
fact: Rithelm Drake remembered an abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner.
source_quote: he eventually recalled an abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner

subject: Rithelm Drake
fact: Rithelm Drake offered to buy the party a drink after learning they were adventurers.
source_quote: When we started asking about the monastery, he seemed confused, but then, surprisingly, he remembered... Once he realized we were adventurers, he offered to buy us a drink

subject: Gonnathrad Kevanarial
fact: Gonnathrad Kevanarial is a High Elf Diplomat with long wavy black hair and grey eyes.
source_quote: Gonnathrad Kevanarial, a High Elf Diplomat, entered the scene, a skinny man with long, wavy black hair and grey eyes

subject: Gonnathrad Kevanarial
fact: Gonnathrad Kevanarial was dressed in a fancy red tunic.
source_quote: dressed in a fancy red tunic.

subject: Gonnathrad Kevanarial
fact: Gonnathrad Kevanarial wanted to be part of an adventure story and offered to write a five-page backstory.
source_quote: he became overly excited at the prospect of being a "quest giver", even offering to write a five-page backstory for us

subject: Gonnathrad Kevanarial
fact: Gonnathrad Kevanarial issued a letter of permit to the party.
source_quote: he actually gave us a letter of permit

subject: Black Earth cultists
fact: The Black Earth cultists were responsible for stealing the chest and killing Calmer.
source_quote: After our recent skirmish with the Black Earth cultists, we secured the stolen honey

subject: Black Earth cultists
fact: The Black Earth cultists were followers of earth and were targeted by Lareth.
source_quote: These are cultists of earth. We just solved a problem for him.

subject: Black Earth cultists
fact: The Black Earth cultists possessed notes indicating the chest was in a monastery.
source_quote: The notes we found with the Black Earth cultists explicitly mentioned a monastery in the mountains as its location.

subject: Terjon's Temple of St. Cuthbert
fact: Terjon at the Temple of St. Cuthbert required a tithe to revive Calmer.
source_quote: offering it as a tithe to Terjon at the Temple of St. Cuthbert

subject: Terjon's Temple of St. Cuthbert
fact: Terjon’s followers might withhold healing magic from non-followers.
source_quote: Jaroo... noted that the Terjon (implied to be followers of St. Cuthbert like Terjon) might withhold healing magic from non-followers.

subject: Kingdom of Celene
fact: The Kingdom of Celene was the intended ally in a treaty secured by the chest.
source_quote: the chest's true purpose was to secure a treaty with the Kingdom of Celene.

subject: Viscounty (Verbobonc)
fact: The Viscounty (Verbobonc) planned to use the treaty with Celene to wage war on the gnomes.
source_quote: The Viscounty (Verbobonc) intended to use this alliance to wage war on the gnomes and seize their gem mines.

subject: Caer Ostverk
fact: The elves at Caer Ostverk were willing to pay for information on the chest’s location.
source_quote: it was also rumored that the elves at Caer Ostverk and Lord Denelu were willing to pay well for information on the chest's location.

subject: Caer Ostverk
fact: Caer Ostverk would pay 100 gold pieces for the letter of permit and information on the chest.
source_quote: it promised 100 gold pieces as a reward when presented to Caer Ostverk

subject: chest location
fact: The chest is located in an abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner.
source_quote: an abandoned monastery near Gallow's Corner

subject: Lareth's true motive
fact: Lareth sent the party to eliminate rival cultists to increase his own power.
source_quote: We just made him more powerful.

subject: political manipulation
fact: The chest may be tied to a plot by the Viscounty to wage war on the gnomes.
source_quote: The Viscounty (Verbobonc) intended to use this alliance to wage war on the gnomes and seize their gem mines.

subject: Calmer’s resurrection
fact: Calmer’s body is intact and can be raised from the dead.
source_quote: Calmer’s dead body is on the ground. Intact. It can be raised.

subject: Gonnathrad's misunderstanding
fact: Gonnathrad Kevanarial mistakenly believes the party is on a traditional adventure quest.
source_quote: he was so caught up in the "adventure story" of it all, he didn't even seem to care why we wanted to go to an abandoned monastery.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr saved Sequoia and Zinnia during the battle.
source_quote: I saved Sequoia and Zinnia.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr planned to negotiate with Thalsor the next day.
source_quote: Zephyr shouts, “We’ll negotiate tomorrow, Thalsor.”

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr took a bow position during the assault on Thalsor’s compound.
source_quote: Zephyr will take a position where he can attack with bows.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr killed Thalsor with his bow attacks.
source_quote: My attacks and Zephyr’s attacks strike him down quickly.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr recognized the cultists were not random bandits.
source_quote: These were not some random bandits. Lareth said some random bandits stole a chest. These are cultists of earth.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia realized the operation was a disaster due to poor tactical awareness.
source_quote: The operation was a disaster. Our initial attack was successful, as we overwhelmed with speed and stealth the enemy. But we did not have proper tactical awareness of the enemies assets.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia concluded Thalsor must be killed to prevent exposure of the party’s identities.
source_quote: If we let him live, our identities will be exposed to the cult. Someone will connect us to the village elders. Thalsor needs to die.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia used gaseous form potion to sneak into Thalsor’s compound.
source_quote: Zinnia will take advantage of the chaos to strike.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia killed Thalsor with her attacks.
source_quote: My attacks and Zephyr’s attacks strike him down quickly.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia deduced that Lareth sent them to eliminate rivals.
source_quote: The various elemental factions are at each other’s throats. Lareth wants to get rid of the competition. He sent us here to get rid of his enemies. We just made him more powerful.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia believed they had to save Calmer.
source_quote: “We have to save Calmer.”

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia used a potion of gaseous form to retrieve Calmer’s body.
source_quote: Sequoia has taken position with his potion of gaseous form. He glides towards Calmer’s corpse. Sequoia materializes, grabs calmer’s body and runs.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia agreed with Zephyr’s plan to negotiate with Thalsor the next day.
source_quote: Zephyr looks at me, “How?” Sequoia stares at his wounds, “Tomorrow.” Zephyr nods.
